assets.prompt: Use case: game-asset. Create ONE pixel-art interior furniture sprite for a gritty32px-tile top-down roguelike. Reference1 is Shiori Novella IDENTITY: preserve her distinctive white-silver hair on the VIEWER LEFT and black hair on VIEWER RIGHT, straight bangs, bright amber-gold eyes, black gothic collar and small white ribbon. Reference2 is STYLE only: match its chunky low-detail hard-edged pixel furniture, no smooth anime illustration. Subject: a small framed bust PORTRAIT of Shiori displayed on a short dark wooden floor easel, worn muted brass rectangular frame with ivory corner caps, integrated two short feet at bottom. The portrait should clearly show black/white split hair, pale face, two tiny gold eyes, dark collar. Entire object visible,32x48native pixels (16x24logical pixels),16flatcolors maximum,2shades per material. Slight raised frontal/top-down game perspective; broad readable shapes. Actual transparent background. No letters, text, extra objects, floor, outside cast shadow, gradients, glow, blur, antialiasing, fine detail, multiple views or sprite sheet. A framed picture on a stand, not a living character or full-size statue.
